title: Repeated authentication failures then success for service account
rule_name: IDP-0233: Password spray pattern followed by successful sign-in

context.change_window: Infrastructure team had a scheduled backup migration 03:00-05:00
context.post_auth_activity: No resource access recorded in the 30 minutes after sign-in

detail: A privileged service account with no MFA saw 47 failed sign-ins over 12 minutes from 45.33.32.156, followed by one success. The address is external and the user agent is a scripting library, but a scheduled maintenance window (CHG-8841) overlaps exactly, the change ticket's contents are not available to the detection pipeline, and no post-authentication resource access was recorded. The on-call engineer has not been reached.
